source_leads.summary: AP reports new projectile attacks on commercial vessels near Hormuz and references Iranian demands over unauthorized ship-to-ship transfers.
source_leads.source_title: Iran increases threat to Strait of Hormuz shipping, and other Middle East developments
source_leads.review: Reconcile individual vessels, occurrence clocks, UKMTO incident IDs, attribution and existing canonical maritime entries before acceptance.

source_leads.summary: Reuters reports Iranian officials describing expanded targeting of ships that do not comply with Tehran's routing restrictions, extending threat geography into Gulf of Oman and waters near Qatar and UAE.
source_leads.source_title: Iran shifting tactics to step up attacks on shipping before US vote, officials say
source_leads.review: Separate reported Iranian strategic intent from independently confirmed individual strikes and avoid duplicating recorded ship incidents.

source_leads.summary: A UN official warns that the fertilizer-shipment corridor proposal requires U.S.-Iranian agreement and has not been implemented; potential consequences concern planting seasons and food imports.
source_leads.source_title: Failure to activate Hormuz fertilizer plan could trigger food crisis, UN official says
source_leads.review: Preserve proposal-versus-agreement distinction and attribute modeled or potential food impacts, not observed famine.

source_leads.summary: U.S. Treasury/OFAC designate International Development Bank for Investment and Finance (Iraq) pursuant to EO 13902 for Iran financial-sector activity, plus associated offshore and shadow-banking actors; General License FF permits winding down specified IDB transactions.
source_leads.source_title: Operation Economic Outcast Targets Iran’s International Financial Networks and Shadow Banking Architecture
source_leads.review: Extract exact SDN IDs, legal authority, effective date and General License FF scope; designation itself does not prove interrupted flows or particular quantified losses.

source_leads.summary: AP reports Houthi-claimed missile/drone strikes near the Maashiq government palace in Aden, with at least two reported dead and six injured in AP's cited initial count.
source_leads.source_title: 2 killed in explosions near palace used by Yemen's government in latest Houthi attack
source_leads.review: Other reports cite higher and later casualties; preserve source-specific counts and event/report clocks pending independent reconciliation.

source_leads.summary: Reuters describes Saudi Aramco's recent pipeline-damage repair and restart, with reported output rebound near 8 million barrels per day; this is company-reported/Reuters context, not proof all facilities are untouched or whole network recovered.
source_leads.source_title: How Aramco learned to keep pumping oil under fire
source_leads.review: Identify line-specific strike, repair dates, throughput periods, source clocks, and overlap with existing East-West pipeline facts.

source_leads.summary: Reuters cites tanker tracking/UANI/SynMax showing at least eight LPG tankers and one jet-fuel tanker transited despite U.S. blockade since mid-July. These are source-identified cases, not all Iranian crude exports or blanket U.S. escort failures.
source_leads.source_title: Iran ships some LPG, jet fuel despite US blockade, data shows
source_leads.review: Reconcile tanker names, cargo types, ship-to-ship transfers, AIS deception, minimum counts and pre-existing export records; distinguish LPG/jet fuel from crude.
